flaws.note: The search term is interpolated into $queryRawUnsafe; a quote in ?q= rewrites the query.
PATCH /users/me spreads the request body into prisma.user.update; only passwordHash and id are stripped, so a customer can set role to ADMIN or take another email.
The Stripe event is parsed from the raw body without stripe.webhooks.constructEvent; anyone can mark any order PAID.
